title: Admin-editable Workout Library muscle-group cards, flexible exercise media URLs, and clearer Blog edit access

requirements.summary: Add an admin UI for managing muscle-group card display content and render admin-managed image/description in Workout Library with fallbacks.
acceptanceCriteria: An admin can update each muscle group’s display content (at minimum: image URL and description text) from an admin/creator UI.
WorkoutLibraryPage muscle-group cards render the admin-managed image/description when present; if missing, they fall back to the current default images/labels.
Non-admin users cannot edit muscle-group card content.
Changes persist across refreshes and deployments (uses existing canister state).

file_operations.description: Add React Query hooks for fetching muscle-group card details and saving admin edits (read via existing backend capabilities for muscle groups; write via the existing admin-only update capability).

Create an admin-only MuscleGroupManagement UI to edit per-muscle-group card fields (image URL and description at minimum) and save updates through existing backend capabilities. If using stored blobs, use the blob-storage ExternalBlob direct URL for previews (verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).
Wire the new MuscleGroupManagement into the Creator Dashboard (e.g., as a new tab/section alongside existing management tools) so admins can find and update muscle-group card content.

Load muscle-group display content from backend-driven muscle-group card data and render it on each muscle-group card (image + description). Preserve current hardcoded mapping as fallback when admin-managed values are missing; keep non-admin users read-only.

requirements.summary: Update the exercise editing flow to accept externally hosted image/video URLs while keeping required-field validation and improving preview fallbacks.
acceptanceCriteria: ExerciseManagement allows saving exercises with either site asset paths (e.g., /assets/...) or external URLs (e.g., https://...) for imageUrl and videoUrl.
ExerciseManagement continues to validate required fields (name, cues, imageUrl, videoUrl), but does not block regular updates by requiring /assets/ URLs.
Workout Library exercise preview cards continue to display each exercise’s imageUrl (with a sensible fallback if missing/unreachable).

file_operations.description: Relax URL validation to allow external http(s) URLs for imageUrl/videoUrl (still require non-empty values). Update helper text to reflect that external URLs are supported and ensure regular updates are not blocked by /assets-only rules.
Harden exercise preview card rendering to use a sensible fallback when an exercise image URL is missing or fails to load (fall back to the muscle-group card image).

requirements.summary: Make Blog editing easy to discover for admins by adding an admin-only navigation affordance from the public Blog page to the existing Creator Dashboard BlogManagement workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: An admin can create, edit, publish/unpublish, and delete blog posts from the Creator Dashboard using the existing BlogManagement UI.
From the public Blog page, admins have a clear navigation path to the blog editing area (e.g., a visible “Manage Blog” button/link for admins only).
Non-admin users do not see admin-only blog editing navigation or controls.

file_operations.description: Use the existing admin-check query to conditionally render a clear admin-only “Manage Blog” action that routes to the Creator Dashboard area where BlogManagement already exists.
